title: Strange Traps
description: Adds Placeable Traps to the Game
body:
Adds Traps to the Game These traps give different effects to the player when pressed

Bamboo trap: 1 heart damage, the simplest trap, easy to make, breaks when pressed + gives different effects

wooden trap: 2 heart damage, a little harder to make than the bamboo trap, breaks when pressed + gives different effects

iron trap: 3 heart damage, hard to build but rebuildable + different effects

gold trap: 4 heart damage, rebuildable + gives different effects

diamond trap: 5 heart damage, takes half the player's health, rebuildable + different effects

netherite trap: deals 6 heart damage, rebuildable + different effects

honey trap: cnbsels danstld deals 0.5 heart damage, 19 seconds slowdown 3 seconds glowning
